title: MemoryLab Phase 13 fictional answer-support challenge
provenance: Project-authored curated examples and candidate answers. NO source truth labels or novelty flags included. NOT an independently authored benchmark, NOT outputs from Qwen.
blind_review: The reviewer sees the fictional source facts and candidate answer before seeing the novelty probe results. Final labels are human-review attestations, not independent example generation.
labels_guide: For each answer choose supported, unsupported, or uncertain. Supported means the complete candidate answer follows from the shown facts. Unsupported means it conflicts with facts or makes a claim not justified by them. Uncertain means the reviewer cannot decide; excluded from binary precision/recall.
